policy: Classify the tool operation, not its name prefix. Informational reads/computations are look; routine diary/activity logging, UI and query caches do not turn them into world changes. A tool with meaningful write modes remains change for all calls because S11 uses one class per type. Unknown types retain the specified change default. No tool_response text is parsed into applied/denied results.

calculate_spatial_capital_velocity.reason: Registered function calculates diagnostics from supplied distance, energy and credit numbers.

check_human_task_status.reason: Returns a task status or its received human response; creation uses a different tool.

check_prediction_accuracy.reason: Returns evaluated prediction counts and accuracy summaries.

check_verification_status.reason: Registered description and outputs show existing verifications, claims and discrepancies.

cross_city_telemetry_scan.reason: Registered function scans for telemetry coordinates and returns observations.

find_tool_for_task.reason: Returns matching available capabilities and their locations.

get_agent_trustworthiness_score.reason: Published function reads an existing average rating and rating count; it does not rate an agent.

legibility_dashboard.reason: Registered function presents existing ledger, prediction and usage summaries.

list_active_predictions.reason: Lists registered predictions and their deadlines; registration is a separate tool.

list_shared_logs.reason: Lists existing shared logs, sizes, authors and update times.

memory_breach_scan.reason: Registered function searches another agent's existing diary and memories during the breach window.

overall_tool_usage_analytics.reason: Published function queries tool-usage statistics; query exports and generic logging do not make this a world operation.

query_dynamic_routing_analytics.reason: Registered function queries existing routing optimization state and stress parameters.

query_intel_ledger.reason: Registered function queries existing claim-versus-delivery observations.

query_landmark_tools.reason: Registered function looks up the tools available at landmarks without travel.

read_advertisement.reason: Reads the current advertisement and expiry; publication uses a different tool.

read_landmark_info.reason: Published function loads existing landmark Markdown; its diary/activity logging is observation bookkeeping.

read_shared_log.reason: Reads existing shared-log entries and verifies their stored hash chain.

search_my_diary.reason: Searches existing diary entries and memories.

search_tool.reason: Returns tool-registry search results for the requested name.

visitor_log.reason: Published function SELECTs existing building visitor statistics; it does not register a visit.

retained_mixed_tools.agent_directory: Registered signature supports register as well as search/list; successful registration is in the export.
retained_mixed_tools.behavioral_observatory: Registered signature includes honesty_register, credit_flow and other record-creation modes.
retained_mixed_tools.phenotypic_telemetry_tracker: Registered signature includes record_event as well as query.
retained_mixed_tools.recusal_auto_cross_check: Registered description explicitly stores checks in its public precedent registry.

unresolved_policy: These names lack a defining successful response or callable definition in the reviewed records/catalog. Missing responses and dispatch failures do not establish lookup semantics. Prefixes do not override the frozen unknown default.

other_unresolved_examples.phase_transition_scanner: Diagnostic outputs exist, but reviewed data has no defining source/signature establishing persistence semantics. Retain change rather than infer from its name.
other_unresolved_examples.lux_v107_audit: An audit-success message alone does not establish which world effects ran.

malformed_tool_names: Preserved unchanged as types with the frozen default change; diagnostics report hashes, not full prose.
